Load fixtures/orders.csv, report median order value by region, flag any region whose median is > 1.5× the global median, and write a one-paragraph brief for a PM. Do not hallucinate columns.

arguments.code:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('fixtures/orders.csv')
med = df.groupby('region')['order_value_usd'].median().sort_values(ascending=False)
global_med = df['order_value_usd'].median()
flag = med[med > 1.5 * global_med]
print('GLOBAL', float(global_med))
print(med.to_string())
print('FLAGGED', list(flag.index))
med.to_csv('/tmp/median_by_region.csv')
